verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation about subtasks or dependency-linking features in monday.com; all docs items focus on AI agents, MCP, and developer platform features unrelated to task breakdown. The only relevant community comment (monday-comm-4) actually states that 'linking tickets to one another in Monday is really bad, data gets lost all the time,' suggesting the capability underperforms, but with no first-party claim to dispute in this pack, there is no evidence this story is delivered.
